Evidence behind the diagram

Each node on the model-on-a-page diagram claims a stage — Live, Building or Planned. That word is not an opinion: it is computed from the levels of the named atoms the claim rests on. This page is the drill. For every node it shows those atoms, the artefacts the map cites for each, the tests, and the ledger entry that recorded the level move — and, where any of that is absent, it says so rather than showing a tidy blank.

Nothing here is hand-typed. Every figure and path on this page is generated from site/data/moap_node_atoms.json, docs/design/maturity_map.yaml, docs/observability/gate_authorizations.jsonl and docs/observability/test_execution_log.jsonl. Citations are shown as inert tags carrying their disk status, never as links: these are repo paths, not web pages, and a dead citation dressed as a live link is the defect this page exists to avoid.
